p.title: Portfolio return attribution — market, sector, stock, FX, cash
p.symptom: The portfolio read gave one 3-month gap to the index with no split of where it came from.
p.root_cause: The read compared two weighted means and stopped.
p.fix: src/domain/portfolio/attribution.js: on the current composition, book return = 지수 + 섹터 (US sector ETF vs market) + 종목 선택 + 환율 (USD/KRW 63-session move for converted holdings), and R − B = 섹터 + 종목 + 환율 + 현금 (−cash share × blended index) exactly. US market return is SPY adjusted (same basis as stocks and sector ETFs); KRX uses the KOSPI/KOSDAQ index. A converted holding without an FX return is skipped, not counted at zero. The 지수 대비 sentence and a bar breakdown come from this one computation.
p.violated_rule: Takeover review of v57.18 (2026-10-04): a number must state what it was computed on, a validation claim must be about the model actually on screen, and a gate is fixed by making the producer state its evidence — never by skipping the records it rejects.
p.prevention: ci-review-integrity-unit-check P1466 (identity, FX inversion, skip rule, sentence source).
p.verification: Synthetic book: 섹터 +1.8 · 종목 +3.0 · 환율 +1.32 · 현금 +0.3 = +6.42%p = R − B.
